posts.title: Light Dependent Reactions in Thylakoids
posts.body: Chlorophyll inside thylakoid membranes absorbs photon energy to split water ($2\text{H}_2\text{O} \to 4\text{H}^+ + 4e^- + \text{O}_2$), generating ATP and NADPH.
posts.analogy: Like rooftop solar panels generating immediate direct current to charge your inverter batteries before evening.

posts.title: The Stomata Security Gate
posts.body: Guard cells swell when water enters, bowing outward like a pair of curved bananas to create an open pore for $\text{CO}_2$ entry.
posts.analogy: Just like a metro station automatic gate that slides open only when the sensor registers passenger flow.

posts.title: Board MCQ: Source of Released Oxygen
posts.body: A critical 1-mark CBSE question: Where does the molecular oxygen produced during photosynthesis actually come from?

quiz.question: Which molecule is photolyzed to release $O_2$ into the atmosphere?
quiz.explanation: Isotope tracer studies proved that photolysis of water ($2\text{H}_2\text{O} \to 4\text{H}^+ + 4e^- + \text{O}_2$) releases the oxygen gas, not carbon dioxide.

posts.title: Agrivoltaics in Kutch & Punjab
posts.body: Agrivoltaic systems mount solar panels over crops. The panels shade vegetables from scorched noon heat while plants keep the panels cool through transpiration.
posts.analogy: Engineering synergy: clean electricity above, high-yield agriculture below.
posts.subject: Science

posts.title: CBSE Trap: Desert Plant Stomata
posts.body: Desert plants (xerophytes) take up $\text{CO}_2$ at NIGHT and prepare an intermediate acid, preventing water loss under hot daytime desert winds.
posts.subject: Science

posts.title: Mid-Feed Recap: 3 Essential Steps
posts.body: 1. Absorption of light energy by chlorophyll. 2. Conversion to chemical energy and splitting of water. 3. Reduction of $\text{CO}_2$ to carbohydrates.
posts.analogy: Stepwise factory workflow turning sunshine and air into sweet starch.
posts.subject: Science

posts.title: Myth: Dark Reactions Happen in the Dark
posts.body: Dark reactions (Calvin cycle) do not require darkness! They are simply 'light-independent' and utilize ATP and NADPH produced during the daytime.
posts.analogy: Like cooking dinner with pre-charged solar batteries: you don't need direct sun on the pan.
posts.subject: Science

posts.title: Board MCQ: Starch Test Reagent
posts.body: Which chemical test is used to detect presence of synthesized starch in a destarched variegated leaf?

quiz.question: Which reagent produces a blue-black colour in the presence of starch?
quiz.explanation: Iodine reacts with amylose in starch to form a dark blue-black inclusion complex.

posts.subject: Science

posts.title: Xylem vs Phloem Transport
posts.body: Xylem conducts water and minerals unidirectionally upwards via suction pressure ($P$), while Phloem translocates sucrose bidirectionally utilizing ATP.
posts.analogy: Xylem is an escalator going strictly up; phloem is a delivery van travelling both directions.

posts.title: Board MCQ: Energy Currency in Cells
posts.body: What molecule carries high-energy phosphate bonds synthesized during photophosphorylation?

quiz.question: Which molecule acts as the cellular energy currency synthesized during light reactions?
quiz.explanation: Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP) stores energy within terminal phosphoanhydride bonds.

posts.title: Master Summary: Photosynthesis in 2 Sentences
posts.body: Plants capture solar radiation via chlorophyll to split water and assemble glucose from $\text{CO}_2$, releasing atmospheric oxygen as a byproduct. This fundamental biochemical cascade sustains almost all aerobic life on Earth.
